disclosure: public summaries only; full internal reports and core technical details excluded

title.zh: MA 进展审核公开摘要

status.zh: 阶段内部复核已完成，后续验收继续

scope.en: A public summary of recent client engineering checks.
scope.zh: 近期客户端工程检查的公开摘要。

items.en: Recent communication, notification behaviour and companion-client work were reviewed against dated engineering evidence.
items.zh: 已根据有日期的工程证据复核近期通信、通知行为和电脑关联客户端相关工作。

items.en: Targeted local checks were completed. Local checks are kept separate from release approval and real-device acceptance.
items.zh: 已完成本轮定向本地检查；本地结果与发行审核、真机验收分别记录。

items.en: Follow-up remains open for dependency review and complete device acceptance. This summary does not certify every production service or app release.
items.zh: 依赖复核与完整设备验收仍有后续工作；本摘要不构成所有生产服务或应用版本的安全认证。

items.en: Key implementation details and the full internal review remain private. Product availability follows the official release notes.
items.zh: 关键实现与完整内部审核不公开；产品可用状态以正式发行说明为准。

title.zh: AstroAI Chain 进展审核公开摘要

status.en: Research and acceptance work in progress
status.zh: 研发与验收工作持续推进

scope.en: Nontechnical progress and assurance-stage information only.
scope.zh: 仅披露非技术进展与审核阶段。

items.en: The team continues engineering, validation and documentation work. Recent registered progress was checked against internal evidence.
items.zh: 团队持续推进工程、验证与文档工作；已依据内部证据复核近期登记的进展。

items.en: Targeted internal verification has progressed. Production readiness and independent review are assessed separately.
items.zh: 定向内部验证已有进展；生产就绪与独立审核另行评估。

items.en: Production acceptance remains incomplete. This update is not a mainnet-launch announcement, security certification or performance guarantee.
items.zh: 生产验收尚未完成；本更新不代表主网正式上线、安全认证或性能保证。

items.en: Protocols, architecture, implementation, deployment information and private review materials are not disclosed.
items.zh: 协议、架构、实现、部署信息与内部审核材料均不公开。

title.zh: 官网公开安全检查摘要

status.zh: 已有外部自动化检查结果

scope.en: The public website only; not the MA app or AstroAI Chain.
scope.zh: 仅限公开官网，不覆盖 MA 应用或 AstroAI Chain。

items.en: MDN HTTP Observatory returned B+, score 80, with 11 of 12 tests passed on 1 November 2026.
items.zh: 2026 年 11 月 1 日，MDN HTTP Observatory 返回 B+、80 分，12 项通过 11 项。

items.en: Qualys SSL Labs completed checks of two observed website endpoints: A+ and A. These are separate endpoint results.
items.zh: Qualys SSL Labs 完成两个被测官网入口的检查，分别为 A+ 与 A，两个入口结果分开记录。

items.en: Website dependency review recorded follow-up findings. Automated grades are scoped observations, not independent human security audits.
items.zh: 官网依赖复核记录了后续待办。自动评分是限定范围的观察，不是独立人工安全审计。

items.en: The original provider pages and dated response snapshots are linked in this review centre.
items.zh: 原服务结果页面及有日期的响应快照已列在审核中心。

text.en: Mobile security verification requirements and testing guidance; no project conformity claim.
text.zh: 移动应用安全验证要求与测试方法；不代表本项目已符合该标准。

text.en: Application security verification requirements for planning future reviews.
text.zh: 应用安全验证要求，可用于后续审核规划。

text.en: Public package vulnerability data; dependency matches need reachability triage.
text.zh: 公共依赖漏洞数据；匹配公告后仍需判断实际可达性。

text.en: Open-source repository practice checks. No result was available for our website repository in this review.
text.zh: 开源仓库安全实践检查；本轮未取得官网仓库评分。

text.en: Openly readable security review examples across software, cryptography and blockchain.
text.zh: 可公开阅读的软件、密码学与区块链安全审核案例。

text.en: Public assessment examples for applications, cryptography and infrastructure.
text.zh: 公开的应用、密码学与基础设施安全评估案例。

text.en: Version-scoped contract audit references and a security-review process example.
text.zh: 按版本列示的合约审计参考与安全审核流程示例。

text.en: Public open-source audit engagements and reports; sponsorship or a free engagement is not guaranteed.
text.zh: 开源项目公开审计案例与报告；不保证本项目可获资助或免费委托。
